columns_never_fillable.reason: PRIME operates as a single geographical/business segment (US office); no segment note and no per-property NPI is disclosed. Only portfolio-level NPI of US$75.975m is disclosed (Statement of Comprehensive Income, p139).
Property profile cards disclose Net Lettable Area (NLA) only; GLA/GFA not disclosed.
All 13 properties are Freehold (fee simple) US office; no land-lease term/expiry exists.

Debt hedged/fixed 67% to mid-2026 and beyond; debt headroom US$92.5m to 50% gearing; undrawn facilities US$76.1m (p5).
Weighted average interest rate 5.1% (5.11% incl. amortisation, Note 9 p166); interest coverage 2.0x (p... financial review).
Portfolio: 13 Class A freehold US office properties, 4.2m sq ft NLA, 215 tenants across 23 sectors, 80.0% leased occupancy, WALE 4.4 years by NLA (p5, p19-20).
Completed new financing of US$550m in FY2024; total units in issue 1,308,259,171 as at 14 Mar 2025 (bonus issue 1:10 completed 28 Mar 2024).
Price-to-book 0.31x based on closing unit price US$0.171 on 31 Dec 2024 (p5).
